name: pw-flaky-inconclusive
notes: End-to-end §12-1/§12-3 decision (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-28-playwright-adapter-design.md): a Playwright retry that fails then passes must not read as a clean repair. A gitignored attempt counter (outside the git tree, so tree_digest is unchanged across runs -- same technique as adv-flaky-no-inference) drives a deterministic sequence: run A (attempts 1,2, both fail) is baseline-red; run B (attempt 3 fails, attempt 4 retry passes -- Playwright outcome 'flaky') carries a finding on a pass verdict, and because playwright-native/1 always declares instrument.capabilities['retry-evidence']='pass' (recorder.ts PLAYWRIGHT_CAPABILITIES), compare classifies the A->B transition as transitions.verification_inconclusive (not repaired_same_surface) with outcome_verdict 'inconclusive', and gate (ref HEAD~1, run B) reads verdict 'inconclusive' with 'verification_inconclusive' triggered instead of a clean pass. An unrelated tracked change (c2) is committed between run A and run B so that (a) HEAD~1 resolves to c1 at all and (b) run B's provenance.head differs from c1's commit, keeping the git-ref baseline scan (compare.ts resolveBaseline, mode 'git-ref') from matching B against itself -- run A's tree_digest still equals c1's tree because the counter file is gitignored. Finally run C (attempts 5,6, both fail again) demonstrates the event registered in the design doc as an accepted side effect: baseline B (pass+finding) -> current C (red) is new_fail/regressed, not a downgrade from the flaky classification.

steps.content: unrelated tracked change so the flaky run's tree differs from c1
